changes.reason: Extends the battle impact feedback fiche with team transitions: recall and send-in on a switch, a fainted friend fading before the next steps in or before the defeat screen, and a level-up beat after a win or capture. All beats are derived from the already-resolved turn events and snapshots, so active friend, HP, XP, rewards and saves are unchanged; the name line keeps the pre-round level until the level-up beat.
